title: Public ABI catalog schema
description:
Deterministic public catalog produced from all compilable `info.toml`
contract entries.

contracts.description: Compiled ABI entries sorted by their stable contract IDs.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the public catalog JSON format.

BundledContract.description: One compiled contract entry in the public ABI catalog.

compilerAbi.description: Compiler-generated ABI JSON emitted by `acton compile --abi`.

hashes.description: Sorted unique lowercase hexadecimal code hashes for this ABI.

knownAddresses.description: Sorted unique friendly TON addresses known to use this ABI.

links.description: Sorted unique project and contract references.

Link.description: External reference attached to a project or contract.

title.description: Human-readable label shown to catalog consumers.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL for the referenced resource.
